BrochureContent.Content:
Occupying an enviable position within the prestigious Hanover Dock development, No. 75 an exceptional duplex penthouse that offers an outstanding blend of contemporary design, generous proportions and spectacular waterfront views comes to the market for sale.

Extending to approximately 130 sq. m. (1,399 sq. ft.), this remarkable three-bedroom property is arranged over two beautifully appointed levels, creating a home of exceptional quality and distinction. Designed to maximise natural light and its unique waterside setting, every principal room enjoys an atmosphere of space, privacy and sophistication.

At the heart of the home lies an elegant open-plan living and dining space, perfectly suited to modern living and entertaining. Floor-to-ceiling glazing frames captivating views across the Docklands, while seamless access to two private balconies creates a wonderful connection between the interior and its spectacular surroundings.

Crowning this exceptional home is a magnificent private roof terrace located off an additional living/primary suite space—an increasingly rare feature in Dublin’s apartment market. Overlooking Hanover Dock and the vibrant waterfront skyline, it provides an extraordinary setting for al fresco dining, entertaining guests or simply enjoying the ever-changing panorama from sunrise to sunset.

The accommodation comprises three generously proportioned bedrooms, including a superb principal suite, complemented by two stylish bathrooms. Thoughtfully designed throughout, the property also benefits from two spacious storage cupboards, ensuring everyday practicality without compromising its clean, contemporary aesthetic.

Constructed in 2006 and boasting a BER B energy rating, the property combines modern comfort with energy efficiency, making it an ideal city residence, executive home or premium investment opportunity.

Hanover Dock is widely regarded as one of Dublin’s premier residential addresses, situated at the centre of the vibrant Grand Canal Dock district. Home to world-leading technology companies, acclaimed restaurants, cafés, theatres and cultural venues, the area offers an unrivalled lifestyle where business, leisure and waterfront living seamlessly converge.

The property enjoys immediate access to Grand Canal Dock DART Station, the Luas, Dublin Bus services and an extensive network of cycle routes, while St. Stephen’s Green, Grafton Street and Trinity College are all within comfortable walking distance.
Properties of this calibre seldom come to market. Combining an exceptional duplex layout, expansive outdoor space, panoramic dockside views and one of Dublin’s most coveted locations, No. 75 Hanover Dock represents a rare opportunity to acquire a truly outstanding penthouse in the capital’s most dynamic neighbourhood.


Disclaimer: The above particulars are issued by Herbert & Lansdowne Estate Agents on the understanding that all negotiations are conducted through them. Please note that we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only.
